Rockville Personal Training FAQs

Do I need a home gym for Fit2Go to come to Rockville?

No. We bring adjustable dumbbells, kettlebells, suspension trainers, and mobility tools to condos and single-family homes. If your building has a fitness center—like The Daley at Shady Grove or Twinbrook Quarter—we’ll reserve the space and layer in specialized equipment.

How flexible are session times around I-270 traffic?

We prioritize pre-commute blocks (5:30–8:30 a.m.) and post-commute evenings (6:00–8:30 p.m.) so you’re training when roads are clear. Midday sessions are popular with remote professionals near Rockville Town Square who want a productive break without driving.

Does Fit2Go cover North Bethesda and Potomac too?

Yes. Rockville is our service hub for Montgomery County. We regularly train clients along Montrose Parkway, in Potomac Woods, and at Pike & Rose. If you live slightly outside the core, we’ll confirm availability during your free consultation.

What results can Rockville clients expect?

Most clients report higher energy, stronger lifts, and better posture within six weeks thanks to personalized programming and accountability. We layer nutrition guidance and habit coaching so your progress survives long project sprints and Metro delays.
